WallStyle.Straight: Straight (floor plan with hexes on top)

Preset.Applied: Size applied to map and rooms.

Field.Name: Scene name
Field.WallStyleHint: Straight: rooms and corridors with flat walls; each hex belongs to the side its center is on. Only matters on hex grids.
Field.MapSizeHint: In grid hexes/squares (in GURPS, 1 hex = 1 yard).
Field.TeleportRoomsHint: Rooms with no access on foot. Only reachable through a teleport circle (both ways).
Field.TeleportConfirmHint: Shows a confirmation when stepping on the circle instead of teleporting right away.
Field.PresetHint: Fills in map and room sizes at once.
Field.RoomSizeHint: Smallest and largest side of a room, in hexes.
Field.ExtraLoopsHint: Extra links between rooms, for alternate paths.
Field.CellSizeHint: Image resolution. 100 works for almost everything; raise it only for heavy zoom.
Field.LightPlacementHint: On the walls: 1 to 4 torches per room depending on size, away from doors.
Field.SecretRoomsHint: Linked by a narrow passage ending in a Foundry secret door. Players see a wall until the GM reveals the door.
Field.ScenesHint: 1 = a single scene. More than 1: creates several scenes in a folder, side by side (4 = 2×2). Corridors leave through the edge into the neighbor scene, at the same height.
Field.LayoutHint: Caves: natural caverns linked by tunnels, no doors. They look best with "Follow the grid" walls.
Field.LockedChanceHint: Foundry locked door: opens only when the GM unlocks it. On the image it has iron bands and a lock.
Field.TrapsHint: Hidden in corridors (in caves, anywhere on the floor). Only the GM sees them. Stepping on one posts a chat card with GURPS rolls.
Field.EntranceHint: Stairs on a wall of room 1. The scene opens centered on it.
Field.PlacePartyHint: Places each player's character next to the stairs.
Field.JournalHint: A journal with one page per room and numbered map notes (GM only). For linked scenes, also an overview map.
Field.PillarSpanHint: The ceiling rests on the room's shorter side. If that side exceeds this span, pillars go in a grid: ⌈width ÷ span⌉ − 1 by ⌈length ÷ span⌉ − 1. Reference: timber 4–5, stone slab 3–4, vault 6–8, carved rock 5–6. In caves they become natural columns.
Field.AssetFolderHint: Images named: floor, door, door-frame, pillar, entrance and torch (standard 200 px per 5-ft square). Anything missing is drawn by the module.

Setting.FloorTextureHint: Seamless tiling image for floors. Empty = drawn by the module.
Setting.RockTextureHint: Seamless tiling image for rock/walls. Empty = drawn by the module.

Set.Done: "{name}": {count} scenes created in the folder, {links} of {total} links (seed {seed}).

Editor.Title: Edit floor plan

GDC.Created: "{name}" created: {rooms} rooms, {doors} doors, {secret} secret, {lights} lights, {traps} traps (seed {seed}).

pit.Name: Hidden pit
pit.Effect:
{token} stepped on a trapdoor!

Roll [Per-2] to notice in time and step back.

Failure: falls 3 yards for [1d+1 cr]. A [DX-2] roll lets them grab the edge.

darts.Name: Poisoned darts
darts.Effect:
{token} triggered a pressure plate!

Roll [Per-3] to hear the click in time.

Failure: [Dodge] against 1d3 darts of [1d-2 imp]. Anyone hit rolls [HT-2] against the poison.

blade.Name: Swinging blade
blade.Effect:
{token} broke a tripwire!

Roll [Per-2] to spot the wire first.

Failure: a blade swings down — [Dodge-1] or take [2d cut].

gas.Name: Sleeping gas
gas.Effect:
{token} released a jet of gas!

Roll [Per-4] to smell it in time.

Failure: [HT-3] or fall asleep for 1d minutes.

spikes.Name: Spike plate
spikes.Effect:
{token} stepped on a loose plate!

Roll [Per-1] to notice the plate.

Failure: spikes shoot up — [1d+2 imp] to the foot; a [DX] roll halves the damage.

Journal.Name: {name} — Journal
Journal.SecretRoom: Secret room: reached through a secret door in room {room}.
Journal.TrapsHint: Traps are regions only the GM sees. Each fires once and then turns itself off (you can turn it back on in the region).
Journal.Pillars: {n} pillar(s) holding up the ceiling (block movement and sight; provide cover).

Regen.Title: Regenerate dungeon
Regen.Confirm:
Generate a new dungeon in this scene, with the same options and a new seed?

Floor plan, image, walls, lights, traps, teleports and the journal are rebuilt. Tokens and exits to other scenes are kept.

Notes written in this scene's journal will be lost.
